quotes.text:
Why didn't you want a full-time job?
  1     You are financially secure, but work because you want to
  2     You earn enough working part time
  3     You want to spend more time with your family
   4       You have domestic commitments which prevent you working full-time
   5       You feel that there are insufficient childcare facilities available
   6       You have another reason

May I just check, what were the reasons you did not look for work (in the last 4 weeks)
    1        Waiting for the results of an application for a job/being assessed by a
             training agent
    2        Student
    3        Looking after the family/home
    4        Temporarily sick or injured
    5        Long-term sick or disabled
    6        Believe(s) no jobs available
    7        Not yet started looking
    8        Do(does) not need employment
    9        Retired from paid work
    10       Any other reason

May I just check, was the main reason that you did not look for work because...
    1       Were you caring for children below school age,
    2       Were you caring for other children,,
    3       Were you caring for a dependent adult relative,
    4       or some other reason?

assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaire does not record domestic or care work performed by respondents through dedicated questions or time-use modules separate from main and secondary paid employment. Instead, domestic commitments and caring responsibilities for family members or children are only listed as options explaining why a respondent works part-time (e.g. YNOTFT) or why a respondent did not look for work (e.g. NOLOWA, NOLWF). Under the operational instructions, mentioning domestic work only as a category of inactivity or a reason for not working or working part-time does not satisfy the requirement, placing it in the treated_as_other classification.
